relationship_model.directionality: Every person-to-person perception is directional. A->B trust is not automatically equal to B->A trust.
relationship_model.initial_values_policy: null means unknown/unmeasured. Never set 50 as a fake neutral bond. Relationship values only change through validated events and agent-specific perception.
relationship_model.knowledge_policy: Each NPC stores what it experienced, inferred, or was told. It does not receive the other party's private knowledge automatically.

household_model.definition: A household is a persistent co-residence and/or shared domestic-resource unit. It is not automatically a family, business, legal institution, or social group.
household_model.membership_basis: Confirmed co-residence, shared domestic resources, or another explicit household arrangement.
separation_rules: Family relationship does not prove co-residence.
Shared address does not prove kinship.
Temporary lodging is not automatically a permanent household.
A workplace or institution is not a household.
household_model.economic_link: Shared assets, expenses, debts, and contributions refer to SR-10 accounting records; the social registry cannot create wealth.

background_population_import_contract.expected_input: A JSON array or object containing the exact persisted NPC IDs from the existing 120 background population.
background_population_import_contract.rule: Only explicit, source-backed household_seed_id/family_group_id/explicit_relationships are imported. No demographic or family structure is guessed from name, profession, district, or shared affiliation.
